description: React component for the Moments feature in the web application, managing moments state, preferences, and UI rendering.

classes.name: Moments
classes.description: React functional component implementing the Moments feature, including toggling moments, selecting tags, and taking photos.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the Moments feature, activating user premium modal if not entitled.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the Moments feature on or off based on current state.

methods.name: takePhoto
methods.description: Triggers the camera to take a photo if user is entitled to files.

methods.name: selectTag
methods.description: Sets the default Moments tag based on user selection.

methods.name: unselectTag
methods.description: Clears the current Moments tag selection.
